info.name: Delete existing User Roles by Ids.

params.name: ids
params.description: To delete User Roles based on the specified list of IDs, the IDs need to be separated by commas. This endpoint allows partial deletion; if you provide a list of five IDs and only three of them are valid, then it will delete those three User Roles. The response will indicate the three that were deleted, and the two invalid IDs will be listed as errors.
